entries.02d197858a87e8a5: This business engages in television and radio broadcasting, production of programs, films, anime and events, sales of video and music software, advertising, mail-order sales and other activities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥349,876 million, the largest of the reportable segments (previous year: ¥403,479 million). The company explains that, due to an incident at its subsidiary Fuji Television Network, Inc., terrestrial TV advertising revenue fell sharply, mainly in the first half. On the other hand, it states that its content business remained solid, including subscription income from the streaming service “FOD” and hit films.

entries.2b512ed72897fad9: Advertisers purchase TV and radio advertising slots, and the main counterparties are advertising agencies. As a share of revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, Dentsu Inc. accounted for 8.2% (¥45,251 million) and Hakuhodo Inc. for 4.8% (¥26,470 million). Tenants, hotel guests and others use the buildings and hotels.
entries.2e05878cf5b1c51e: In May 2026, the company published 'Group Vision 2026-2030 Ver.1.0.' The company says it will shift from the conventional structure, in which terrestrial TV advertising revenue is the main source of income, to a system that consistently covers everything from creating and nurturing IP to diversified expansion, starting from IP and content. Terrestrial broadcasting will be repositioned as the core for developing IP. For the Urban Development and Tourism Business, the company is considering introducing external capital and taking assets off the balance sheet, but it explains that the methods, timing and scale have not been determined.

entries.5d4a757e5dd7256e: This business rents out buildings, trades in real estate, and operates hotels and resorts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥192,859 million, up from ¥140,431 million in the previous fiscal year. The company explains that the increase in revenue was due to the sale of owned and developed properties, the sale of large-scale condominiums, a full year's contribution from Kobe Suma Sea World, and hotel occupancy that captured demand from inbound visitors to Japan.
